payload.reason: The evidence describes how audio and text sequences are combined in their RNN architecture.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to independently encode audio and text data.
The audio-RNN encodes MFCC features and concatenates them with prosodic features to form an audio encoding vector.
The text-RNN encodes the word sequence of the transcript to create a textual encoding vector.
The final audio and text encoding vectors are combined to predict the emotion class.
